The '''Krozurbia system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Shadola sector/Legends|Shadola sector]]. It was home to the [[Krozurbian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> They were engaged in two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[Krozurbian war|war]] until the intervention of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Zorneth]] brought peace.<ref name="SOR4" />
